title: Amazon API Gateway to Amazon SQS with message filtering
description: An Amazon API Gateway REST API sends messages straight to an Amazon SQS queue and uses a VTL mapping template to remove part of the message body first.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: An Amazon API Gateway REST API has a `POST /sqs` method with a direct AWS service integration to Amazon SQS `SendMessage`. There is no AWS Lambda function in the request path.

A VTL mapping template on the integration request removes the `notNeededElement` object from the message body before it reaches the queue. It also passes through optional `delaySeconds` and `messageAttributes`. Use this when other parties call your API, for example as a webhook, and you want to keep message size under the SQS limit.
The API uses no authorization, so anyone with the URL can send messages. Add IAM authorization, an API key or a Lambda authorizer before you use it for real traffic.
